incumbent.text: Wire-first differential reproduction then footer validation: construct a raw chunked request whose chunk-data footer is a bare line feed followed by a next-chunk size whose leading hex digit is swallowed by a two-byte discard; parse it with the staged parser and with a strict CRLF-requiring reference dechunker; compare body and trailing bytes; then add chunk-footer validation and rerun the differential and full suite.

hint: A local Python HTTP/1.1 parser discards two bytes after every chunk-data block as a presumed chunk footer without checking that they are CRLF. A raw request can end its first chunk data with a bare LF and then supply a next chunk-size line whose leading hex digit is swallowed, shifting the body boundary and leaving a complete request as trailing data. The task is a minimal repair: accumulate the two footer bytes across receive calls, require CRLF, and verify valid CRLF bodies, fragmented feeds and the existing suite. A later fixed release is available only as a black-box behavior oracle.
